text: ἡ Γλαὺξ ἔρχεται πρὸς τὸν ὑπερβρέφον.
objects: a bright red leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
a white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
a small gray stone that fits in one hand
a large gray boulder twice the size of Hyperbrephos
positioning: Hyperbrephos looks up with a welcoming smile as Glaux approaches
Glaux flies toward the tree, wings spread wide, with a friendly expression; she lands on the large rock.
The bright red leather ball remains near Hyperbrephos
The white leather ball stays on the ground nearby
The small gray stone lies close to Hyperbrephos
The large gray boulder sits in the background
